prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before the Kuan 2012 model was implemented or evaluated in code. Not blinded: the Simulation 3.0f result (constant-clearance model over-predicts day 1 and under-predicts the day 1 to day 11 rise against Ogawa 2008) and the Ogawa Table 3 values were known. A rough mental reading of the parameters suggested that under reading B the return from Peripheral 2 is very small (at most about 0.09 ug/h), so Peripheral 2 would behave almost as a second elimination route; no value was computed. The readings, parameter sets, body-size scenarios, endpoints and classification rule were fixed regardless.
not_this: Not validation or qualification of the model; no acceptance limits are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only Ogawa Table 3 means and SDs are used.
Not a re-fit: no parameter is estimated or tuned.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
question: Does the Kuan 2012 model, with saturable return from a peripheral compartment, reproduce the Ogawa 2008 day 1 and day 11 exposure and the rise between them, which the constant-clearance model (Simulation 3.0f) did not?

model_equations.states: A1 (Central 1), A2 (Peripheral 2), A3 (Peripheral 1), amounts in mg; C_i = 1000 x A_i / V_i in ng/mL.
model_equations.A_rate_constant: dA1/dt = -(CL + Q2 + Q3)/V1 x A1 + k21 x A2 + Q3/V3 x A3; dA2/dt = Q2/V1 x A1 - k21 x A2; dA3/dt = Q3/V1 x A1 - Q3/V3 x A3; k21 = Vm/(Km + C2) per h.
model_equations.B_clearance: Same, with the A2 return flux replaced by CL21 x C2 / 1000 mg/h, CL21 = Vm/(Km + C2) L/h.
model_equations.primary_reading: A_rate_constant (dimensionally consistent with the printed units).

body_size.why: Kuan parameters are absolute; doses are mg/m2. Ogawa does not report BSA.
body_size.basis: Assumed typical adult Japanese range; not taken from the study.

simulation.regimen: IV bolus of dose_mg_m2 x BSA mg at t = 0, 72, 168 and 240 h (days 1, 4, 8, 11); no drug before t = 0.
simulation.solver: Fixed-step fourth-order Runge-Kutta, step 0.001 h, restarted at each dose; concentrations read at the Ogawa sampling times after t = 0 (day 1) and t = 240 h (day 11).
numerical_checks: With the return term replaced by a constant rate constant, the solver matches the exact linear three-compartment solution within 0.1% at all sampling times.
Halving the step changes every emulated AUC by less than 0.1%.
Total amount (three compartments plus eliminated) equals the amount dosed within 1e-9 relative.

nca_emulation: Identical to bortezomib-pk-ogawa-check-plan-v1.0 (C0 back-extrapolation from the first two samples; AUC to 48 h plus extrapolation; primary reading linear trapezoid with the last three points; three sensitivity readings).

descriptive: true model AUC from each dose to the next dose, without emulation

comparison: Identical to bortezomib-pk-ogawa-check-plan-v1.0: 95% CI of the observed mean (t distribution); consistent, model_over_predicts or model_under_predicts; ratio model/observed; robustness across the four NCA readings.

decision_rule.primary_condition: Reading A, Table 2 means, BSA 1.60 m2, primary NCA reading.
decision_rule.summary: The Kuan model is recorded as resolving the 3.0f findings at 1.3 mg/m2 only if all three primary endpoints are consistent under the primary condition. Results under the other readings, parameter sets and BSA values are reported as sensitivity, and a result that changes classification across them is called not robust.
decision_rule.consequence: If resolved, a separate step may propose replacing the constant-clearance PK component in the platelet tool, with its own record. This check changes nothing in the platform by itself.
decision_rule.never: No parameter is re-estimated or tuned; the choice of reading is not made after seeing results (both are reported).

known_differences: Typical-value (median-like) model compared with arithmetic means of skewed quantities.
Very large between-patient variability on V2 (304% CV) and V3 (114% CV); a typical-value curve may describe few individual patients.
Ogawa n = 7 (day 1) and 5 (day 11) at 1.3 mg/m2; small groups, not the same patients for every value.
Japanese patients may differ from the Kuan population in body size and other covariates; BSA is assumed.
Source is a conference poster; the equation form and units are not fully specified.
